pages.title: Project Overview
pages.goal: Orient a new developer in their first hour: what akashic-record is, the three artifacts (design doc, skill, deterministic core), the division of labor between LLM and script, and where to start reading.

pages.title: Deterministic Core
pages.goal: Document akashic.py command by command: scan filtering, the stale bucket semantics and self-dependency exclusion, verify's citation gate, anchor's hash-preservation rule, and the invariants the test suite proves.

pages.title: Skill Orchestration
pages.goal: Explain how the Claude Code skill drives the pipeline: the generate/update/status flows, the page contract subagents receive, the hard rules (script authority, edit protection, cite-or-omit, hash-null bless signal), and how agents consume the wiki.
